title: Death Note
source: Death Note manga by Tsugumi Ohba and Takeshi Obata (108 chapters).
world: Top student Light Yagami finds the Death Note, a notebook dropped by the bored Shinigami Ryuk: anyone whose name is written in it dies. Light starts killing criminals to build a new world as 'Kira', and the genius detective L hunts him. After L, his successors Near and Mello take up the chase. A tense cat-and-mouse thriller about justice and power.
power_system: The Death Note kills the person whose name is written while the writer pictures their face; a cause and details can be added. Shinigami can trade 'Shinigami eyes' (seeing names and lifespans) for half the owner's remaining life. Only owners of a note can see its Shinigami.

timeline.summary: Light finds the notebook; L challenges Kira on TV.
Misa, the second Kira, appears; Light gives up the note to clear himself, then regains it; L dies.
Light leads the task force while hunting L's successors; Kira is worshipped worldwide.
Near exposes Light at the warehouse; Ryuk writes Light's name.
